body: Founder real-time: 'write a blog post on the updates as pizza.' Published in-character as The Pizza (REDGARDEN hero, docs/HEROES_VS0.md -- permanently on fire, oblivious/deadpan persona, 'nobody has ever confirmed it's actually hurt by that'), covering this session's real burst of shipped work: Enforcement squad difficulty tuning + guaranteed respawn sword, the Krankenvagen wandering-trader-plus-llamas rescue mechanic, Party Store TNT/potion/food overhaul, the team-trained RL model going live in a real new 3v3 queue, and the 6-item shop expansion reaching a real page 4. Published via IDUNA blog API (EMILY-PRIME agent), live at https://okemily.com/blog/nobody-checked/.
title: Blog post published: 'Nobody Checked' by The Pizza, covering this session's REDGARDEN/GTA7 update burst
